bug.title: Deleting a todo while a filter is active removes the wrong item
observed_steps: 00:01 - Add 'Buy milk', 'Walk dog', and 'Pay rent' to the todo list
00:05 - Click the 'Active' filter button so only 'Walk dog' and 'Pay rent' are shown
00:07 - Click the delete (×) button on 'Pay rent'
00:09 - Switch back to the 'All' filter and observe 'Buy milk' and 'Pay rent' remain while 'Walk dog' is gone
bug.expected: Clicking the delete button on 'Pay rent' in the Active filter should delete 'Pay rent' and leave 'Walk dog' in the list.
bug.actual: Clicking the delete button on 'Pay rent' (index 1 of the filtered list) deletes 'Walk dog' (index 1 of the unfiltered todos array), leaving 'Pay rent' in the list.
evidence_timestamps: 00:04 — 'Buy milk' is checked as done above 'Walk dog' and 'Pay rent' in the All view
00:05 — Active filter is selected, showing only 'Walk dog' and 'Pay rent'
00:07 — After clicking delete on 'Pay rent', 'Walk dog' disappears and 'Pay rent' remains visible
00:09 — Switching to the All filter shows 'Buy milk' and 'Pay rent', confirming 'Walk dog' was deleted instead
bug.root_cause_hypothesis: In app/public/app.js, render() iterates over the filtered array returned by visibleTodos() with items.forEach((t, i) => ...) and binds each delete button to deleteTodo(i) (line 79). deleteTodo(index) (lines 36-41) then calls todos.splice(index, 1) on the unfiltered todos array. When a filter hides preceding items, the filtered index i does not match the item's position in todos, causing the wrong todo to be spliced and deleted via DELETE /api/todos/${t.id}.

verdict.original_video_summary: The user adds three todos ('Buy milk', 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent') between 00:01 and 00:04, marks 'Buy milk' as done at 00:04, and switches to the 'Active' filter at 00:05 so only 'Walk dog' and 'Pay rent' are visible. At 00:07, clicking the delete button on 'Pay rent' removes 'Walk dog' instead, leaving 'Pay rent' in both the Active view (00:07) and the All view (00:09).
verdict.fixed_video_summary: The automated test adds 'Buy milk', 'Walk dog', and 'Pay rent' (00:01–00:03), marks 'Buy milk' as done, switches to the 'Active' filter (00:04) where 'Walk dog' and 'Pay rent' are visible, deletes 'Pay rent', and switches back to the 'All' filter (00:05–00:06), showing 'Buy milk' (done) and 'Walk dog' remaining while 'Pay rent' has been removed.
verdict.comparison: In the original recording at 00:07–00:09, deleting 'Pay rent' while the 'Active' filter is selected removes 'Walk dog' and leaves 'Buy milk' and 'Pay rent' in the 'All' view. In the fixed build recording at 00:04–00:06, performing the same deletion under the 'Active' filter and returning to 'All' leaves 'Buy milk' and 'Walk dog' while 'Pay rent' is properly deleted.
verdict.pr_description:
## Summary
Fixes a bug where deleting a todo while a filter (`Active` or `Done`) is applied removes the wrong item from the list.

## Root Cause
In `app/public/app.js`, `render()` iterated over the filtered array returned by `visibleTodos()` and bound each item's delete button to `deleteTodo(i)` using its index `i` in the filtered view. `deleteTodo(index)` then called `todos.splice(index, 1)` on the unfiltered `todos` array, causing an index mismatch whenever preceding todos were hidden by the active filter.

## Fix
- Updated `deleteTodo` in `app/public/app.js` to accept the todo's `id` (`deleteTodo(id)`), filter `todos` by `t.id !== id`, and call `DELETE /api/todos/${id}`.
- Updated the delete button click handler in `render()` to pass `t.id` instead of the filtered loop index.

## Verification
- Added a Playwright reproduction test that creates `'Buy milk'`, `'Walk dog'`, and `'Pay rent'`, marks `'Buy milk'` as done, switches to the `'Active'` filter, deletes `'Pay rent'`, and verifies that `'Walk dog'` and `'Buy milk'` remain while `'Pay rent'` is removed.

rationale: In `app/public/app.js`, `render()` binds the delete button to `deleteTodo(i)` where `i` is the index within the filtered `visibleTodos()` array, and `deleteTodo(index)` splices the unfiltered `todos` array at `index`. When a filter hides preceding items, the filtered index diverges from the unfiltered array index and deletes the wrong todo. Updating `deleteTodo` to accept the todo `id` (matching `toggleTodo(id)`) and filtering `todos` by `id` ensures the clicked item is removed regardless of active filters.
otherBugs: In app/server.js, the PATCH /api/todos/:id handler compares numeric `t.id` against string `req.params.id` with strict equality (`===`), causing todo completion state changes to return 404 and revert when the user reloads the page.

In app/public/index.html, `.title` has `white-space: nowrap` without overflow handling, so long todo titles push the delete button off the right edge of the `overflow: hidden` list item and make it unclickable.
